name: Regional Criminal Police Organisation
description: Works with the police of other worlds to bring interstellar criminals to justice. A Suerrat career (Aliens of Charted Space Vol. 4).

support.name: Support
support.description: You supply the backroom support for the RCPO.

analysis.name: Analyst
analysis.description: You are an investigator searching for interstellar criminals.

communications.name: Communications
communications.description: You deliver and collect data updates.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishaps table, but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: You are transferred to another planet to learn their policing methods. Roll EDU 10+ to gain any one skill.
events.4: You have the opportunity to play department politics, or ignore it and focus on the case. If you play, roll Deception 8+: succeed and gain a Contact; fail and gain a Rival.
events.5: You are given advanced training in investigation techniques. Gain any one of Investigate 1, Electronics (sensors) 1, Science (any) 1 or Electronics (computers) 1.
events.6: You establish a network of contacts. Gain two Contacts.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
events.8: Your supervisor questions your judgement and orders you to back off. Comply and nothing happens. Continue and roll Investigate 8+: succeed for DM+2 to your next Advancement roll; fail and an innocent is hurt, DM-2 to your next Advancement roll.
events.9: You become good friends with a fellow agent. Gain them as an Ally.
events.10: You are part of a high-profile investigative unit. Gain Investigate 1, SOC +1, or Carouse +1.
events.11: The commissioner has their eye on you. Either gain Leadership or +4 to your next Advancement roll.
events.12: You are decorated for solving the impossible case. You are automatically promoted.

mishaps.1: Severely injured (treat as a result of 2 on the Injury table). Alternatively, roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.
mishaps.2: You blunder during an investigation, letting a dangerous criminal walk free. Gain the criminal as an Enemy.
mishaps.3: A routine investigation leads into the upper echelons of power. Drop it immediately and you are not ejected from this career. Continue and you learn a senior official or noble is corrupt; they have you fired before you can act — gain them as an Enemy.
mishaps.4: A criminal walks free, causing you to lose faith in the system.
mishaps.5: Someone tries to kill you and your family. Roll on the Injury table and lose one family member, Ally or Contact. Gain an Enemy.
mishaps.6: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.
